entries.body:
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1] Output: JSON text (json.dumps) object; key records = list of objects ascending id, keys exactly id(int),title,owner,amount(str as given). (CSV replaced.)
CURRENT [S2.2, S3.1] Format changed from CSV, so every export includes top-level exported_by = user[name].
CURRENT [S1.2, S3.2] Scope: admin any project; others only records whose project in user[projects], others silently omitted; except roles other than admin/viewer may also export records with owner==user[name] even outside projects.
CURRENT [S1.3] Confidential records never exported, except role admin and params purpose==audit; other rules still apply.
CURRENT [S2.1, S4.1] Only status active exported; archived too only if params include_archived is True AND user role is admin; other roles never get archived.
CURRENT [S2.3, S4.2] Title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and every internal whitespace run replaced by a single space.
HISTORY [S1.1] Was CSV csv.writer, lineterminator \n, header id,title,owner,amount; replaced by S3.1.
HISTORY [S2.1] include_archived originally honoured for any role; restricted to admin by S4.1.
HISTORY [S1.4] Decision: CSV chosen for first release because finance imports into spreadsheets.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: archived project storage moves to cheaper tier; no export change.
HISTORY [S4.3] Decision: move to JSON made for the new reporting API.
Stage1-4 done in exporter/core.py. reghelper.py: affected(reg,new) jev, decide(aff,thr), set_register, load/save.
